Introduction
This document outlines the 
equipment Inspection list I1, which must be performed every six month as indicated by M6 in the above title block.
The first draft initiated 
by eng Medhat Fouad, tested at 05 June 2003, revised by EDEPC quality 
control eng. Abouda Elbana, accepted by general 
manager eng Ali Mostafa El_Lithy and approved by Mostafa Alaam Talkha PS Head 
Sector.
This document is accepted by eng. Samir 
Abd El Gilil EDEPC MPIS coordinator, and certified by accountant; Mahmoud 
Mohamed Soliman; EDEPC admin and financial inspection, quality control General 
Director and supervisor of inspection and quality control head sector.
Safety Precautions
A 
 work permit must be issued, the qualified maintenance staff should carry the 
 suitable safety category
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work area is required.
Wear safety and healthy equipment as safety helmets shoes, gloves, etc
Isolate the circuit breaker of the 
pump motor
Disconnect electric terminals of the 
pump motor.
The
pump must be isolated mechanically by 
closing delivery and suction valves.
Be sure pump must be completely 
drainage.

 what to do (if it is needed).

 re-tightens it (if it is needed).
Check level and the validity of 
 bearing oil and add or change it (if it is needed).

Check flanges for water leakage.
Check the pump casing against rust
